post.summary: Capture a URL or a note
post.description:
Store a URL or a note and queue whatever work it implies.

A URL becomes a webpage source and is fetched; text becomes a note and is indexed
immediately. An excerpt alongside a URL is stored as its own clip, so the user's
own words are never lost to a fetch that fails.

post.description: Extract a readable preview from a URL so the user can confirm before saving.

LintFindingOut.title: LintFindingOut
LintFindingOut.description:
One lint finding.

`id` is optional because a report contains findings that have just been detected
and not yet written -- requiring an id here made the endpoint 500 on the common
path, which is exactly when someone is looking at the lint panel.

SearchFilters.title: SearchFilters
SearchFilters.description:
Narrowing applied to both the lexical and the vector leg.

Defaults follow the plan: only the document's *current* version is searched, so
a superseded sentence cannot be cited as present-tense fact. Callers that want the
history (the belief-diff views, for instance) opt in explicitly.

TokenOut.title: TokenOut
TokenOut.description: The plaintext `token` is present exactly once, in the create response.
